messages:
Alex M.: Heads-up — t-minus 45 for the 'turnstile' quiet window. Quick checklist below, post green or call blockers.
- confirm canary pin applied
- smoke tests passing
- rollback owners acked
- release notes final

release-bot: Autoscheduling freeze enabled for branch release/turnstile-v3.2.

deploy-bot: Pin applied to canary: `model-serving:v3.2-canary` (pin id: pin-8921).

Priya S.: @Sam T., @Jorge R. — can you ack rollback ownership for this slice?

Sam T.: Ack. I'm primary rollback owner for turnstile. Rollback command staged:
```
./scripts/rollback --slice turnstile --to-tag v3.1.9 --force
```

Jorge R.: I can take monitoring & db revert. One blocker: rerank feature-flag default = ON in prod (infra-config PR #4321). Should we gate before launch?

Alex M.: Where is the flag wired up? Is it a customer-visible change?

Jorge R.: It's in the rerank path, customers might see subtle scoring diffs. PR merged earlier but defaults are enabled. @Priya S. can you check the flag state?

Priya S.: Checking now — infra PR merged but flag default is true. Rolling it back to false in prod now.
`curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags/turnstile_rerank -d '{"value":false}'`

deploy-bot: Canary smoke summary: p95 latency: 82ms, error rate: 0.15% (threshold 0.5%). Streaming tests still running (ETA ~6m).

Alex M.: OK. Leave canary pinned. Post-deploy watch: 15m. Abort criteria: error rate >0.5% OR p95 latency jump >200ms. If triggered, Sam run rollback command above and notify #release-war-room.

Sam T.: :thumbsup: watchers and pager rules set. Rollback runbook: https://wiki.internal/releases/turnstile-rollback (pinned).

release-bot: Draft release notes snapshot saved: /releases/turnstile-v3.2/draft. Added short note about embeddings-cost tweak.

Priya S.: Added context-limit change to notes (customers may see shorter context despite perf gains).

Alex M.: Green from me. @Sam T., @Jorge R. — you have 30m active watch. I'll apply final signal and start the quiet window.

Alex M.: FINAL: go for silent freeze. Pin id pin-8921 remains. Starting quiet window now.

deploy-bot: Quiet window started at 6060606065. Canary pinned. Monitoring alerts forwarded to #eng-oncall.

Jorge R.: Watching dashboards — nothing anomalous so far, cpu/latency stable.

Sam T.: Rollback drill ready but standing down. Good job team :tada:
